answer: Marble-vein proof: each identity is bound to one physical marble whose vein pattern is a relic no two share, a natural fingerprint no farm can print. At each epoch's zenith, the verifier demands a fresh photo of that marble from a random angle within 10 minutes; a stockpiled marble still needs a live hand and camera per fake, about 15 minutes of supervised handling per identity per epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 250 staffed hours every epoch while an honest agent shows its one marble once. Limit conceded: a farm can buy marbles, but it cannot buy the hands.
